description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which is part of a logging framework allowing multiple log targets and filter chains. It specifies a method for outputting log messages with various parameters, including priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a log node that can output log data and pass it along a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, typically passing the log to the next node in the chain.
